constraints.rule: No air bubbles in optical wells, cuvettes, or microfluidic channels prior to readout
constraints.rationale: Air bubbles in optical chambers, microplate wells, or microfluidic channels scatter excitation/absorbance light paths and obstruct laminar fluid flow.

constraints.rule: Pipetted liquid volume must match target step volume within ±5% (ISO 8655 micropipette tolerance)
constraints.rationale: Volumetric pipetting errors exceeding ±5% alter reagent stoichiometry, standard curve dilution accuracy, and binding kinetics.

constraints.rule: Complete all required buffer washes between binding steps
constraints.rationale: Incomplete washing or residual buffer leaves unbound reagents, elevating background signal and reducing assay signal-to-noise ratio.

constraints.rule: Protect photosensitive substrates and fluorophores from direct ambient light
constraints.rationale: Photosensitive substrates (e.g. TMB, fluorophores, HRP conjugates) undergo photobleaching or spontaneous photo-oxidation under direct ambient light.

constraints.rule: Replicate spots or duplicate wells must agree with CV <= 15%
constraints.rationale: Replicate coefficient of variation (CV) > 15% indicates technical variance from multiple candidate causes (pipetting error, air bubbles, or uneven washing).

constraints.rule: PCR thermal cycler annealing temperature drift must not exceed ±1.5 °C
constraints.rationale: PCR primer-template hybridization requires strict thermal control; excursions >1.5 °C cause non-specific amplification or primer dropout.

constraints.rule: Organ-on-a-Chip endothelial perfusion wall shear stress must remain <= 15.0 dyn/cm²
constraints.rationale: Two-phase slug flow or excessive pump velocity generating wall shear stress > 15 dyn/cm² strips endothelial VE-cadherin tight junctions.

constraints.rule: CRISPR-Cas9 LNP polydispersity index (PDI) must remain <= 0.20
constraints.rationale: Gas pockets or flow-ratio drift in staggered herringbone mixers disrupt chaotic advection and spike LNP PDI above 0.20.

constraints.rule: ÄKTA FPLC column back-pressure must not exceed 0.50 MPa
constraints.rationale: Air entering the packed agarose resin bed or frit fouling increases back-pressure and causes mobile-phase channeling.

constraints.rule: Mammalian cell culture media pH must remain within 6.8–7.6
constraints.rationale: Mammalian cell culture media must remain within physiological bicarbonate buffer window; shifts indicate metabolic acidification or CO2 incubator drift.
